$description: Font-family primitives. `sans`, `serif`, `mono` vendored from Tailwind v4 defaults. `neo-grotesque` is a Luxen-specific stack used by the badge element; override per project.

font-sans.$value: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Noto Color Emoji'

font-serif.$value: ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif

font-mono.$value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

font-neo-grotesque.$description: Luxen-specific neo-grotesque stack (badge, labels). Override at :root to use a project font.
